verdicts.explanation: The 0.0123 S/cm Nernst-Einstein value is the paper's own MD-based estimate for the neat EC-LiTFSI system (EC:Li=48:1) at 425 K, so origin is computational and the 151.85 °C conversion is correct. The 'pure EC' wording is loose, but the system is the neat electrolyte.

The 4.7×10−4 S/cm value for the methanol-esterified pectin-glycerol-LiClO4 gel at 68 wt.% glycerol is attributed to Andrade et al. (ref 32) in the Introduction, so literature_cited is correct; room temperature is stated and no numeric temperature is required.
The 1.96×10−3 S/cm value for pectin + LiCl is attributed to Perumal et al. (ref 33) in the Introduction, so literature_cited is correct, and the paper gives no temperature, so null is right.
The 5.38×10−5 S/cm value for 40 wt.% LiClO4 + 60 wt.% pectin is quoted from the Perumal et al. work (ref 33) in the Introduction, so literature_cited is correct, and no temperature is stated.
The 2.62×10-5 S/cm value at PEO:corn starch = 9:1 is reported for Lin et al. (ref 21) in the Introduction, so literature_cited is correct, and the paper gives no measurement temperature.
